name: afra-panel
description: Afra Panel — Cloudflare-first self-hosted proxy management platform

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @afra/control-plane && npm run typecheck -w @afra/edge && npm run typecheck -w @afra/web
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @afra/control-plane
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run deploy -w @afra/control-plane && npm run deploy -w @afra/edge
